test_live_view_controls.title: Verify live view controls on main page

steps.expected: The Setup button is shown and Camera time shows a value.

steps.action: Read the page for the channel and screen controls.
steps.expected: Channel select and the Full screen button are present.

steps.action: Read the page for the lens controls.
steps.expected: Zoom, Focus and Auto focus are present, with Focus and Calibrate buttons.

test_speaker_and_alarm_controls.title: Verify camera speaker and alarm controls on main page

steps.action: Open the camera's main page and read the controls under the live view.
steps.expected: PC speaker and Cam speaker controls are present.
Alarm input, Relay out and Motion indicators are present.
Camera time shows a date and time.

test_security_pages_accessible.title: Verify user management and security configuration pages

steps.expected: The user list is shown and includes the root user.
The RTSP authentication page is shown.
The IP address filter page is shown.
The HTTPS settings page is shown.
